text: Operation Trojan Horse. Austin. The injection run completed. Forty-seven million systems took a signed backdoor, and for nine days nothing will happen at all.
style: SAFETYNET director reading a night that has already happened. Consistent British Received Pronunciation accent throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low, deliberate, unhurried even under a countdown. He does not raise his voice and he does not soften anything.
